entities.summary: Gregory VII, a notable figure in the history of Holy See, associated with Papal States & Investiture Controversy (1050–1122). Preceded by Pope Leo III crowns Charlemagne Emperor and Donation of Pepin establishes the Papal States. Their legacy influenced Emperor Henry IV does penance before Pope Gregory VII at Canossa and First Crusade.
